key_insight: Diffusion-generated ABX₃ structures broaden perovskite composition coverage, but reliable bandgap-targeted discovery requires topology checks and property validation.
engineering_relevance: The workflow could expand the search for solar-cell absorber candidates, but predicted bandgaps alone do not establish device suitability.
method: Generate candidate ABX₃ crystals with a pretrained diffusion model.
Filter for three-dimensional corner-sharing perovskite connectivity.
Predict bandgaps with MP-trained ALIGNN and assess six structures using first-principles calculations.
evidence_signal: The generated target-window fraction was 8.2% versus 7.3% for the Materials Project reference; ALIGNN did not beat a constant baseline on a severe B-site-disjoint test.
watch_item: Separate MatterGen and ALIGNN label sources prevent a claim of target-condition enrichment, while relaxation can change structural classification.
paper_title: Diffusion-Based Generative Screening of ABX$_3$ Perovskite Compositions for Bandgap-Targeted Materials Discovery
